C146.notes: SER AS-HK-001. Value side big 1 · Chinese 壹圓 · ONE DOLLAR · 1998 · user shorthand Hong kong + photo (Joseph: that Hong Kong got some nice history). For more than a century Hong Kong’s circulating dollar carried the British monarch — Victoria through Elizabeth II — colonial CuNi in every ferry turnstile and dai pai dong dish. On 1 July 1997 sovereignty passed from the UK to the PRC; this 1998 Bauhinia piece is early SAR-era pocket change with the orchid flower instead of the Queen. Hong Kong flips now 1.
